protocol: The item graph was selected on an April 19-21 temporal holdout after fitting on April 9-18, then refit on April 9-21. Official April 22-28 outcomes were used only for reporting and four user-ID-modulo residual folds. No random-log or hidden-test outcome was accessed.

experiments.name: centered-outcome item co-exposure graph
experiments.architecture: An item-item cosine graph built from every training exposure, with inverse-user-frequency weighting, transfers each user's item-centered historical long-view residuals to candidate items. This is distinct from the earlier co-positive ItemKNN and user-neighbor graph.
experiments.selection: The April 19-21 temporal screen selected inverse-user-frequency power 0.5 and Bayesian transfer smoothing 0.5 from 12 candidates, reaching 0.55849640 primary.
experiments.evidence: The April 9-21 refit reached 0.58079550 on raw scores and 0.58118916 after within-user ordinal normalization. Despite materially outperforming the old co-positive ItemKNN's 0.55179089, all four residual folds selected exactly zero weight against the 0.61280465 champion.

experiments.name: legacy co-positive ItemKNN re-audit
experiments.evidence: The retained co-positive artifact reached 0.55179089 standalone after within-user ranking and every residual fold selected zero weight.

experiments.name: retained DCN, AutoInt, and numeric-bilinear interactions
experiments.evidence: The two-layer low-rank cross network reached 0.60764265 and AutoInt reached 0.60788572 standalone; both selected zero residual weight in all folds. Numeric-bilinear interactions reached 0.60732180 and selected 0.005 in one fold only. Its mean fixed weight lowered primary to 0.61280066 and regressed in three folds.

conclusion: A substantially stronger item-item collaborative signal still contained no stable residual ordering beyond the accepted ensemble and user-neighbor correction. Higher-order DCN, AutoInt, and numeric-bilinear predictions also failed the user-disjoint promotion rule, so 0.6128046513 remains authoritative.
